diff --git a/compiler/src/checked_program.trb b/compiler/src/checked_program.trb
index 259cf622..c34eeb8e 100644
--- a/compiler/src/checked_program.trb
+++ b/compiler/src/checked_program.trb
@@ -801,6 +801,18 @@ def gate4_check_postfix(
 		mut locals: Gate4Locals,
 		initial: Gate4CheckedValue,
 	): Gate4CheckedValue
+	# Most operands have no postfix. Preserve their checked result directly;
+	# only a real postfix chain needs the independently rebound local below.
+	mut postfix := gate4_token_is(state, position[0], "(")
+	if !postfix
+		postfix = gate4_token_is(state, position[0], ".")
+	end
+	if !postfix
+		postfix = gate4_token_is(state, position[0], "[")
+	end
+	if !postfix
+		return initial
+	end
 	mut value := array_loop_operands(initial, initial.loop_index, initial.loop_array)
 	mut scanning := true
 	while scanning
diff --git a/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb b/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb
index 2b4207ec..50313da4 100644
--- a/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb
+++ b/compiler/src/mir_loop_bounds_test.trb
@@ -29,6 +29,26 @@ def nested_loop_bounds_operations(): Array<Array<Integer>>
 end
 
 describe("MIR Array loop proof core") do
+	test("validates every field of complete conservative streams") do
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([])).to_equal([0])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]])).to_equal([0])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20]])).to_equal([0])
+		mut field := 1
+		while field < 5
+			mut rows := [[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20]]
+			rows[0][field] = 1
+			expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(rows)).to_equal([- 1])
+			rows[0][field] =- 1
+			expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(rows)).to_equal([- 1])
+			field += 1
+		end
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, - 1]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20], [8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 21]])).to_equal([- 1])
+		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds([[8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20], [8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 21]])).to_equal([0])
+	end
+
 	test("selects only reads dominated by the same immutable Array and index") do
 		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(simple_loop_bounds_operations())).to_equal([0, 4])
 		expect(verify_array_loop_bounds(nested_loop_bounds_operations())).to_equal([0, 6, 7])
diff --git a/compiler/src/checked_postfix_test.trb b/compiler/src/checked_postfix_test.trb
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..c1b4d0e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/compiler/src/checked_postfix_test.trb
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import { gate4_lex } from compiler
+import { gate4_compiler_new, gate4_locals_new } from state
+import { array_loop_operands, gate4_check_postfix, gate4_checked_value } from checked_program
+import { describe, expect, test } from trb/std/test
+
+describe("Checked postfix result ownership") do
+	test("preserves every checked operand field when no postfix follows") do
+		suffixes := ["\n", "+", ")", "]", ","]
+		mut index := 0
+		while index < suffixes.size()
+			mut state := gate4_compiler_new(32)
+			expect(gate4_lex(state, suffixes[index])).to_be_true()
+			mut locals := gate4_locals_new(8)
+			mut position := [0]
+			initial := array_loop_operands(gate4_checked_value("Integer", - 3, 7, 1), 13, 17)
+			value := gate4_check_postfix(state, position, locals, initial)
+			expect(value.type_name).to_equal("Integer")
+			expect(value.category).to_equal(- 3)
+			expect(value.origin).to_equal(7)
+			expect(value.mutable).to_equal(1)
+			expect(value.loop_index).to_equal(13)
+			expect(value.loop_array).to_equal(17)
+			expect(position[0]).to_equal(0)
+			expect(state.diagnostic_count[0]).to_equal(0)
+			index += 1
+		end
+	end
+
+	test("keeps actual postfix results separate from the initial record") do
+		mut state := gate4_compiler_new(32)
+		expect(gate4_lex(state, ".size()\n")).to_be_true()
+		mut locals := gate4_locals_new(8)
+		mut position := [0]
+		initial := array_loop_operands(gate4_checked_value("Array<Integer>", 0, 9007199254740991, 1), - 1, 17)
+		value := gate4_check_postfix(state, position, locals, initial)
+		expect(value.type_name).to_equal("Integer")
+		expect(value.mutable).to_equal(0)
+		expect(value.loop_array).to_equal(17)
+		expect(initial.type_name).to_equal("Array<Integer>")
+		expect(initial.mutable).to_equal(1)
+		expect(initial.loop_array).to_equal(17)
+		expect(state.diagnostic_count[0]).to_equal(0)
+	end
+end
